title: Fluffy Sheep Pasture — Fence Enclosure Puzzle
metaDesc: Place wooden fences to protect fluffy sheep from wolves and optimize pasture scoring with WaSHI ILP.
btnHintTitle: Highlight the next recommended move on the board (H key)
adviceDefensePit: Sheep safe! Plug or isolate the 🕳️ pitfall to reach +{diff} more pt
adviceDefenseExpand: Sheep safe! Adjust fence positions to enclose +{diff} more pt
adviceSafeNeedPoints: The sheep are safe from wolves, but you need +{diff} more pt to reach the goal
adviceFallback: Could not compute model solution or hints (stage remains playable with target score)
legendPit: Pitfall (-5 pts, can be plugged with a fence)
legendBridge: Stone Bridge (+1 pt, passable, cannot place fence)
step1Desc: Block all paths from wolves 🐺 to sheep 🐑 by placing wooden fences. Tap a fenced cell again to remove the fence.
step2Title: 2. Enclose a Rich Pasture to Reach the Goal
step2Desc: Once the sheep are safe, the total score of all tiles reachable by 🐑 (🌱+1, 🍓+5) must meet or exceed the Target Score to clear the stage.
step3Desc: 🌉 Stone bridges are passable but cannot hold fences. 🕳️ Pitfalls (-5 pts) lower your score if enclosed, but driving a fence directly into a pit plugs it and blocks wolves.
stageDefaultOneLiner: Protect 🐑 from 🐺 with {n} fences and reach target score {target} pt

stage-1.title: First Fence
stage-1.oneLiner: Tap a cell to place a fence and protect 🐑 from 🐺

stage-2.title: Strawberry Hill
stage-2.oneLiner: Blocking right next to 🐑 misses the 🍓. Block closer to 🐺 to reach the target score

stage-3.title: Stone Bridge Rule
stage-3.oneLiner: You cannot place fences on stone bridges 🌉. Cross the bridge to claim the southwest 🍓

stage-4.title: Plugging the Pitfall
stage-4.oneLiner: Leaving a pitfall 🕳️ (-5 pt) inside the pasture lowers your score. Drive a wooden fence right into 🕳️ to plug it

stage-5.title: Beyond the Bridges
stage-5.oneLiner: Merely blocking near 🐑 falls short of the target. Push your fences up to the two bridge exits

stage-6.title: Two Birds with One Post
stage-6.oneLiner: Driving a fence directly into 🕳️ (-5) plugs the pit and blocks 🐺 at the same time

stage-7.title: Beyond the Pitfall
stage-7.oneLiner: Plugging the east 🕳️ (-5) cuts off the 🍓 orchard behind it. Leave the path open to claim the orchard

stage-8.title: Decoy Strawberry
stage-8.oneLiner: Chasing the nearby 🍓 runs out of fences. Seal the west with 1 fence and expand the east orchard

stage-9.title: Two Sheep Reunion
stage-9.oneLiner: Enclosing the two 🐑 separately falls short. Connect them through the central corridor

stage-10.title: Pitfall Hill Triage
stage-10.oneLiner: Three 🕳️ (-5) dot the hill. Decide which pits to plug directly with a post and which to wall off

stage-11.title: Three-Way Siege
stage-11.oneLiner: Three 🐺 approach across stone bridges. Find the largest orchard you can protect with 4 fences

stage-12.title: Golden Meadow
stage-12.oneLiner: Use all 5 fences wisely to complete the highest-scoring golden pasture

clearSubtextPit: Current {score} pt / Goal {target} pt — A pitfall 🕳️ (-5 pts) is inside the pasture. Plug it with a fence post or wall it off
clearSubtextExpand: Current {score} pt / Goal {target} pt — Adjust your fences to enclose more 🍓 strawberries and 🌱 grass tiles
